csv_project_name: AE for Delaware Memorial Bridge 1st & 2nd Structures
csv_scope_of_work: The Delaware River and Bay Authority hereby requests the qualifications from all professional engineering firms who wish to compete to provide on-call General Engineering Consulting Services for both structures of the Delaware Memorial Bridge. The primary task assignments will be to conduct annual inspections of the Delaware Memorial Bridge and the adjoining infrastructure. Additional tasks may include, but are not limited to, design and construction inspection services for deck repairs, miscellaneous steel repairs, and steel span painting.
